title: mcp.meta@1
description: The MCP revisions DeepBuild's own MCP servers serve with no handshake (#2855): deep mcp, deep mcp actions, deep-hook's mcp actions and the reading tools. A request whose _meta names one of these as io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion is served on its own, its client named by its _meta; one naming any other revision is answered -32022 with these and mcp.handshake@1's, and reaches no hub. server/discover lists these first.

protocolVersion.description: A revision served with no handshake, oldest first; the last is the newest.

x-closure.closed: each value is a revision with no handshake that all four servers implement; any other is answered -32022
x-closure.reopens: a new major, adding a revision once the four servers are checked against what it changes
